url_field_policy: Each url is a DOI resolver, arXiv abstract page, or official publisher/framework page.
source_methods: first three pages of 18 relevant repository-local PDFs
publisher pages from ACL Anthology, PMLR, ACM, OpenReview, and arXiv

entries.title: Numerical accuracy
entries.relation: Batched and per-slice computations are not guaranteed bitwise equal; documents TF32 accuracy behavior.
entries.reproducibility_limit: No guarantee across different batch shapes, releases, platforms, CPU and GPU.

entries.title: Reproducibility
entries.relation: Defines deterministic settings and their performance/platform limits.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Determinism for a fixed input path is not batch invariance across paths.

entries.title: cuBLAS Results Reproducibility
entries.relation: Documents workspace, stream, atomics, toolkit, and architecture conditions for bitwise reproducibility.

candidate_effect.A: supports frozen workspace and single-stream probe

entries.reproducibility_limit: Does not promise equality across distinct GEMM shapes or toolkit versions.

entries.title: Deterministic Inference across Tensor Parallel Sizes That Eliminates Training-Inference Mismatch
entries.relation: Aligns reduction trees to guarantee bitwise invariant inference across tensor-parallel sizes.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Triton/vLLM/FSDP setting is not the frozen CodeT5 encoder stack.

entries.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
entries.relation: Fixed-shape verification and rollback around a fast path.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Token decoding determinism is not semantic-embedding evidence determinism.

entries.title: Certified Adversarial Robustness via Randomized Smoothing
entries.relation: Separates empirical robustness from a formal probability/radius certificate.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Gaussian input perturbations differ from implementation-level floating-point noise.

entries.title: Improved, Deterministic Smoothing for L1 Certified Robustness
entries.relation: Deterministic partitions for quantized inputs.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Not a direct certificate for GPU kernel variation.

entries.title: Watermarking Language Models with Error Correcting Codes
entries.relation: ECC aggregation, formal detection tests, edit/deletion robustness.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Token-channel assumptions do not establish encoder bit stability.

entries.title: Multi-Channel Spread-Spectrum Code Watermarking
entries.relation: Stable code sites, independent votes, majority vote, and Reed-Solomon outer coding.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Post-hoc transformation watermark differs from generation-time selection.

entries.title: SemStamp: A Semantic Watermark with Paraphrastic Robustness for Text Generation
entries.relation: Semantic embedding LSH and rejection sampling.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Does not claim batch-invariant bit-exact encoder replay.

entries.title: k-SemStamp: A Clustering-Based Semantic Watermark for Detection of Machine-Generated Text
entries.relation: Data-aware semantic partitions improve robustness/sampling efficiency.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Adds codebook identity and Voronoi-boundary stability requirements.

entries.title: Who Wrote this Code? Watermarking for Code Generation
entries.relation: Low-entropy code and selective eligibility.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Token-level method and detector differ from semantic replay.

entries.title: CodeIP: A Grammar-Guided Multi-Bit Watermark for Large Language Models of Code
entries.relation: Grammar-guided validity and multi-bit evidence.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Generation-token method is not final-code-only semantic evidence.

entries.title: Marking Code Without Breaking It: Code Watermarking for Detecting LLM-Generated Code
entries.relation: Syntax-aware eligibility protects correctness.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Detection/exact replay contract differs from V4.

entries.title: Practical and Effective Code Watermarking for Large Language Models
entries.relation: AST-guided adaptive code watermarking.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Different detector inputs and no V4 batch-invariance contract.

entries.title: Disappearing Ink: Obfuscation Breaks N-gram Code Watermarks in Theory and Practice
entries.relation: Negative robustness evidence under semantics-preserving obfuscation.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Targets n-gram schemes, so transfer to structural evidence must be tested.

entries.title: Detecting Code Clones with Graph Neural Network and Flow-Augmented Abstract Syntax Tree
entries.relation: AST plus bounded control/data-flow carries more semantic structure than syntax alone.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Neural GNN representation would reintroduce numerical replay risk.

entries.title: GraphCodeBERT: Pre-training Code Representations with Data Flow
entries.relation: Data-flow edges as program-semantic structure.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Learned embedding remains floating-point and batch-path dependent unless isolated.

entries.title: SynCoBERT: Syntax-Guided Multi-Modal Contrastive Pre-Training for Code Representation
entries.relation: Source, AST and identifiers are complementary modalities.
entries.reproducibility_limit: Does not define canonical final-code-only bit evidence.

entries.title: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms
entries.relation: Defines deterministic operation selection and fail-fast behavior.

candidate_effect.A: supports runtime validation but not cross-shape invariance

entries.reproducibility_limit: The API explicitly does not make an application fully reproducible by itself.

entries.title: Similarity Estimation Techniques from Rounding Algorithms
entries.relation: Foundational random-hyperplane sign hashing; collision probability tracks angular similarity.

candidate_effect.C: opposes calling an unqualified sign hash a semantic certificate

entries.reproducibility_limit: LSH probability theory does not guarantee numerical stability near a hyperplane.

entries.title: A Robust and Secure Perceptual Hashing System Based on a Quantization Step Analysis
entries.relation: Analyzes robustness/security around feature quantization steps and fixed-length hashes.

candidate_effect.B: supports explicit boundary analysis and rejects robustness-by-cosine-only

entries.reproducibility_limit: Image perturbation models and Gaussian assumptions do not bound implementation noise in a code encoder.

entries.title: CodeT5: Identifier-aware Unified Pre-trained Encoder-Decoder Models for Code Understanding and Generation
entries.relation: Defines the encoder family underlying the frozen V3 checkpoint and emphasizes identifier-aware code semantics.
entries.reproducibility_limit: The paper evaluates task performance, not batch-invariant bitwise embeddings.

entries.title: Is Watermarking LLM-Generated Code Robust?
entries.relation: Shows variable rename, dead-code insertion, and other semantics-preserving AST transformations can erase code watermarks.

candidate_effect.D: opposes broad robustness claims without attacks

entries.reproducibility_limit: Evaluates existing token watermarks; results do not automatically transfer to a new structural channel.
